_note: Structural at-a-glance facts for Madurai's urban water supply, extracted from the ADB Tamil Nadu Urban Flagship Investment Program (TNUFIP) IEEs. Tranche 2 IEE Parts 1-3 (Project 49107-005, December 2025/February 2026) for Mullai Periyar Lower Camp dedicated supply scheme. Tranche 3 IEE (Project 49107-010, April 2022) for distribution-network improvements with 24x7 supply across all 81 DMAs. Numbers refresh per ADB tranche publication. Where the IEE engineering tables differ from MMC's public water-supply page, this file uses the IEE values (primary engineering record); _secondary_local_source documents the disagreements so future readers can reconcile.

_secondary_local_source.name: MMC public water-supply page (cross-reference, not primary)
_secondary_local_source.notes: MMC's public-facing summary uses simpler rounded figures than the IEE. We document the disagreements here as a cross-check; the IEE values supersede.

known_disagreements.explanation: MMC's 125 MLD is the design intermediate-stage demand (2034), not the existing plant capacity. IEE Part 2 Table A14.4 documents the actual installed capacity as 71.6 (Line-I) + 47.0 (Line-II) = 118.6 MLD.
MMC's '81' is actually the DMA count, not the operational distribution-zone count. IEE Part 2 page 13 documents 28 distribution zones (12 N + 16 S); Tranche 3 IEE separately documents 81 DMAs.
MMC's 467 km may count only specific main categories or a different vintage; IEE Part 2 documents the full pipe network as ~764 km.
MMC counts 23 'overhead reservoirs'; IEE Part 2 Table A14.8 enumerates 28 existing OHTs (12 North + 16 South). Difference may be how peripheral/standby OHTs are counted.
Both come from MMC's connection register; minor revision difference. Likely same dataset at different snapshot dates.

distribution._zone_hierarchy_note: Madurai's distribution network has multiple overlapping zone schemes. We document each level so readers don't conflate them.
distribution.service_zones_note: High-level admin (5 in North + 7 in South), used in OHT naming (NZ1-NZ14, SZ1-SZ12)
distribution.distribution_zones_note: Operational distribution zones (12 North of Vaigai + 16 South of Vaigai). Each fed by one or more OHTs.
distribution.dmas_today_note: District Metering Areas. 42 covered today via earlier 24x7 schemes + Smart City Mission. 39 in Tranche 3 scope.
distribution.dmas_post_tranche3_note: Newly established DMAs once Tranche 3 100% household coverage rolls out.
distribution._pipe_age_note: About 490 km of existing pipes are 30-40+ years old (CI/AC), with incrustation reducing carrying capacity. Tranche 3 revamps these.

connections._target_note: Tranche 3 targets 100% household coverage at 163,958 households via the 115 newly-established DMAs.
